mapper.select: SELECT A.BROD_FILESEQ, A.BASIC_CODE, A.BROD_STARTDAY, A.BROD_ENDDAY, A.BROD_STARTTIME, A.BROD_ENDTIME, A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.USEYN, A.BASIC_ORDER, B.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, B.STRE_FILE_NM, A.BROD_PALYCNT, SUBSTRING(B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN B.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours FROM TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL A JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL B ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode} AND A.GROUP_SEQ = #{groupSeq} AND A.BROD_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY A.BROD_STARTDAY ASC

SELECT C.BROD_STARTDAY, C.BROD_ENDDAY, C.BROD_STARTTIME, C.BROD_ENDTIME, C.BASIC_CODE, C.ATCH_FILE_ID, B.GROUP_TIMEGUBUN, STRE_FILE_NM, ORIGNL_FILE_NM, D.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM TB_BRODBASICGROUP A JOIN TB_BASICFILEGROUP B ON A.BASIC_CODE = B.BASIC_CODE JOIN TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL C ON B.GROUP_SEQ = C.GROUP_SEQ JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL D ON C.ATCH_FILE_ID = D.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode} AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN C.BROD_STARTDAY AND C.BROD_ENDDAY

SELECT C.ATCH_FILE_ID, D.STRE_FILE_NM, D.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, SUBSTRING(D.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN D.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS fileStreCours FROM TB_BRODBASICGROUP A JOIN TB_BASICFILEGROUP B ON A.BASIC_CODE = B.BASIC_CODE JOIN TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL C ON B.GROUP_SEQ = C.GROUP_SEQ JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL D ON C.ATCH_FILE_ID = D.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE A.BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode} AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN C.BROD_STARTDAY AND C.BROD_ENDDAY GROUP BY C.ATCH_FILE_ID, D.STRE_FILE_NM, D.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, D.FILE_STRE_COURS

SELECT BROD_FILESEQ, BROD_STARTDAY, BROD_ENDDAY, BROD_STARTTIME, BROD_ENDTIME, BASIC_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, USEYN, BASIC_ORDER, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BROD_PALYCNT FROM TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL WHERE BROD_FILESEQ = #{brodFileseq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL ( BROD_FILESEQ, BROD_STARTDAY, BROD_ENDDAY, BROD_STARTTIME, BROD_ENDTIME, BASIC_CODE, ATCH_FILE_ID, USEYN, BASIC_ORDER, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, GROUP_SEQ ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('basicbrodintervalfile_seq'), #{brodStartday}, #{brodEndday}, #{brodStarttime}, #{brodEndtime}, #{basicCode}, #{atchFileId}, 'Y', #{basicOrder}, NOW(), #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{groupSeq} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL SET BROD_STARTDAY = #{brodStartday}, BROD_ENDDAY = #{brodEndday}, BROD_STARTTIME = #{brodStarttime}, BROD_ENDTIME = #{brodEndtime}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId}, USEYN = #{useyn}, BASIC_ORDER = #{basicOrder,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BROD_PALYCNT = #{brodPlaycnt} WHERE BROD_FILESEQ = #{brodFileseq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL ( BROD_FILESEQ, BROD_STARTDAY, BROD_ENDDAY, BROD_STARTTIME, BROD_ENDTIME, ATCH_FILE_ID, USEYN, BASIC_ORDER, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, BROD_PALYCNT, BASIC_CODE, GROUP_SEQ ) SELECT NEXTVAL('basicbrodintervalfile_seq'), BROD_STARTDAY, BROD_ENDDAY, #{brodStarttime}, #{brodEndtime}, ATCH_FILE_ID, USEYN, BASIC_ORDER, NOW(), #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, BROD_PALYCNT, #{basicCode}, #{groupSeq} FROM TB_BRODBASICFILE_IVL WHERE GROUP_SEQ = #{cp_copyGroupSeq}
